name: adversarial-30 (kodand-full500 Nemotron failures, 5-min loop)
source: kodand-full500/report.json 270/500 Nemotron Lightning, filtered to incorrect only, stratified: 12 multi-session + 8 preference + 7 temporal + 3 assistant, sorted by MRR asc (hardest first). Random holdout 30 from remaining incorrect (not in this set) for overfit check.
usage: bun run src/index.ts run -p kodand -b longmemeval -j nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b -m nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b -r adv30 --question-ids $(jq -r '.adversarial30 | join(",")' bench/adversarial-30.json)  # ~5 min, 30 Q, expect ~9/30 baseline (0.30) → win is +5 in 5 min
overfit_rule: Never tune on holdout30. After each win on adversarial30, validate once on holdout30; if holdout doesn't move, kill the idea.
